title: preferences-api
summary: Provides the per-user preference read/write surface of the app. It retrieves and persists per-user key/value preferences scoped to the authenticated user within the `pref_` namespace, sanitising keys to a safe charset, returning a default when unset, and clearing a preference when an empty value is supplied. Unauthenticated requests are rejected and invalid keys yield a bad-request response.
